title: To direct the Secretary of Education to establish a Civic Education and Service Learning Grant Program, and for other purposes.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committee on House Administration, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
